messages:
maria (Product Docs): Heads-up: planning to deprecate the CLI `--sandbox` flag in the next SDK CLI minor (4.x). It collides with our new `--scope` semantics and confuses the samples. Proposing a docs-safe exemption: keep a lightweight shim in the sample repo for 90 days while we update tutorials. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

alex (CLI Eng): +1 on removing --sandbox long term. Implementation note: we can add a compatibility shim in the CLI that maps `--sandbox` -> `--scope=local` when `RWD_SDK_LEGACY_SANDBOX` env var is set. PR ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/712 (WIP)

jonathan (Docs): Important: we need the exact removal date and migration guide before we touch the quickstarts. Can we guarantee the shim will be available for the entire docs freeze window?

maria (Product Docs): Target timeline: announce deprecation today, soft removal scheduled 90 days out. Shim will be enabled by default for sample runners for 60 days then by opt-in via env var for the remaining 30 days. We'll add a clear notice banner in the quickstarts.

rwd-ci-bot: CI status for PR #712: checks/pipeline — running. Preview site (staging): https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-712/quickstarts

sam (Platform): To avoid surprise for Dedicated customers, can we gate the removal behind a feature-flag in the hosted runtime as well? Some infra automation references `--sandbox` assumptions in deploy scripts.

alex (CLI Eng): Good call. We'll keep CLI behavior unchanged for hosted API users unless they opt into the new `--scope` mode. CLI will emit a single startup warning when `--sandbox` is used and no shim is active. Example warning: `Deprecated: --sandbox will be removed in 90 days. See https://redwood.ai/docs/cli-migration`

morty (Legal): Quick note on telemetry language — the samples currently call home for anonymous crash telemetry. If we change CLI flags in tutorials, update the privacy blurb. I can approve phrasing but need final text.

jonathan (Docs): I'll draft the updated migration guide and privacy blurb. Will post on the PR and request review from @morty. Who owns the banner copy?

maria (Product Docs): Jonathan will own the banner and migration guide. Alex, please add the shim and env var with a visible deprecation message. Paula — can we include this in the next release train?

paula (Release): Yes — target minor release 4.1.2 on Thursday. If PR lands by EOD Tuesday we can include it. Otherwise it goes into next train.

lin (Eng-Infra): Heads-up: internal CI images use the CLI in a few ephemeral jobs. We'll need to update the build matrix to include the shim env var for the 60-day default so jobs don't fail mid-rollout. I'll coordinate with @alex to get a small patch in the infra repo.

alex (CLI Eng): Will do. Implementation plan in PR description + small test to assert `--sandbox` still works when `RWD_SDK_LEGACY_SANDBOX` is set.

jonathan (Docs): Draft link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD_migration-draft. I'll add the privacy blurb and the quickstart banner copy by EOD.

maria (Product Docs): Great — next steps: 1) Alex finish PR and add tests, 2) Jonathan push migration guide + banner, 3) Morty approve privacy language, 4) Lin patch CI images, 5) Paula schedule 4.1.2. I'll post a short broadcast to #general once PR merged. :loudspeaker:

sam (Platform): One more ask: add a short checklist for platform teams that script SDK CLI invocations so we can proactively reach out to teams using `--sandbox` in infra.

maria (Product Docs): Good idea. I'll create a simple CSV of repos that triggered `--sandbox` usage in the last 90 days (jq + repo search) and share in the follow-up.

paula (Release): Noted. I'll block the release slot pending PR green and docs preview link.

maria (Product Docs): Thanks everyone. I'll update thread when the staging preview has the banner and the docs draft is ready.

rwd-ci-bot: CI status for PR #712: checks/pipeline — passed. Staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/pr-712/quickstarts (expires in 7 days)
